hypothesis: Putting the real paste-to-editable-map workflow and three reproducible text examples on the ranking URL will improve search-intent satisfaction and rankings for transactional Text queries.
variableGroup: On-page task completion and reproducible examples
changesAllowed: Embedded text input and generation flow on the target URL
Three fixed public examples: product notes, meeting minutes and study notes
Funnel events that record no pasted text or generated content
changesFrozen: Title, meta description, H1 and body content
primaryMetrics: Exact-query and Text-cluster impressions on the target page
Average and median position by query, page, country and device
Google-selected page for the exact query
guardrails: No canonical, robots, hreflang or schema regression
No pasted text or generated user content enters analytics or experiment artifacts
stoppingRule: After deployment, observe for at least 28 days and until the Text cluster gains at least 50 new impressions, using the later condition. Treat exact-query evidence as directional until it gains at least 30 new impressions.
attributionLimitation: Both target pages are planned for the same deployment window. Page-specific effects can be compared, but shared site-level or algorithmic movement cannot be fully attributed to either intervention without the frozen control page.

evaluationSchedule.day0: Record deployment ID and capture after-deployment snapshots
evaluationSchedule.day7: Check crawl/indexation, page ownership and funnel leading indicators; do not decide ranking outcome
evaluationSchedule.day21: First directional ranking review if the cluster has meaningful new impressions
evaluationSchedule.day28OrLater: Earliest keep/rollback decision, only after at least 50 new cluster impressions

nextAction: Deploy the embedded Text workflow with PDF round 1, record the deployment ID, and begin the 28-day/50-impression observation window.
